title: Implied-vs-implied-complex spread compression/expansion states on the vol ETP complex

blindness_declaration.law: D1 outcome-blind proposal: no outcome measurement, no returns conditional on states, no expectancies, no signal arithmetic on prices or indices beyond structural facts already committed in P0/P1/P2 artifacts. Every numeric leaf below is a committed structural fact cited from a sha256-pinned P0/P1/P2 artifact and appears only under committed_citations, representation_identity or feasibility_citation.
blindness_declaration.parameters_symbolic_until: D2/S (frozen before any scored number is seen; no threshold may move after any scored number)

mechanism.narrative: Hedging demand forced to pay the premium. The volatility risk premium exists because insurance demand -- crash-averse holders, mandated funds, tail-hedging ETPs -- persistently bids implied volatility above subsequently realized volatility, and premium sellers supply it until the short-vol complex is crowded. When the implied-vs-realized spread state is extremely compressed, the premium has been crushed by an excess supply of volatility selling: a crowded short-vol state whose unwind, when the premium re-expands, is forced and violent. The committed event inventory itself carries the structural canary for exactly this unwind (the SVXY Volmageddon PRICE_EVENT session, kept in the return stream by the committed layer, never smoothed away).
mechanism.forced_participant: The insurance buyer is forced: whoever needs the protection (mandated hedgers, tail-risk ETPs) must keep rolling it and keep paying the premium regardless of price. Symmetrically, when a compressed premium re-expands, the crowded short-vol complex is forced to unwind at any price -- neither side chooses the timing.
mechanism.late_participant: Flow that enters the short-vol complex after the compression is already public (ETP creation follows the selling popularity), and flow that exits only after the re-expansion has printed: ETP flows lag the premium state in both directions, which is the late-entrant footprint.
mechanism.claim_declared_blind: The spread STATE between the granted implied series (VIX close) and the P2-declared realized proxy identifies compression/expansion regimes in which this forced-flow asymmetry is largest; whether conditioning tradeable ETP legs on that state survives the full measured cost ladder is exactly what D2 measures. Nothing is measured now.
mechanism.economic_magnitude_honesty: Declared honestly: the P2 worst-case round-trip cost ceilings at the primary stress tier (cited under feasibility_citation) are on the order of two thousand basis points on the SHORT-bucket legs. Only extreme premium states -- rare, large, persistent -- can plausibly clear such bounds; mild spread variation is declared uninteresting a priori and the family dies cheap if the state contrast is small.

structural_limitation_p2_gate_c8_verbati: STRUCTURAL LIMITATION (declared, C8): the realized proxy is the realized volatility of the event-adjusted VXX close.  An ETP-leg realized vol is NOT S&P 500 realized vol -- it is implied-complex realized vol: a leveraged, fee-bearing VIX-futures-complex instrument whose realized path embeds roll and decay.  The implied-vs-realized state computed from it is an implied-vs-implied-complex proxy, never the classic implied-vs-spot-realized variance risk premium.
structural_limitation_consequence: Every D2/S conclusion from this proposal must be worded within the implied-vs-implied-complex proxy identity. Any wording of a result as the classic spot variance risk premium is invalid-null (identity violation), not a measured failure; the proxy limitation travels with every downstream artifact of this proposal.

decision_rule_family.state_definition_symbolic: SPREAD_t = a fixed symbolic difference functional between the implied side (VIX close at t) and the realized side (the P2-declared trailing realized-volatility proxy of the event-adjusted VXX close, lookback as committed in the P2 gate, annualization as committed), each side standardized symbolically. STATE_t in {compressed, neutral, expanded} at symbolic thresholds (e.g. quantile thresholds frozen at D2/S before any scored number).
decision_rule_family.action_map_symbolic: Each spread state maps to a symbolic position {long long-vol leg, flat, long short-vol leg} on a symbolic subset of the living event-adjusted ETP legs, with a symbolic hysteresis latch that prevents state chatter and limits round trips.

why_information_differs.v16_close_displace_fade: the shadow fades a first-difference displacement of one instrument's close; this proposal's state is a RELATIVE spread between an implied index level and a realized-volatility proxy -- a variance object, not a price displacement -- and the declared mechanism is forced insurance flow, not mean reversion of a price. D2 tests the claim at the frozen ancestry margin.
why_information_differs.v17_oi_level: the shadow is a derivative open-interest LEVEL form; the frozen consumption set contains no options chain and no open-interest series (EODHD family-2 explicitly not entitled), so no OI re-clock is possible. D2 tests the claim by ancestry pooling.
why_information_differs.dvol_shock: the shadow is a realized derivative-shock form on a different asset complex; this proposal's realized side is a trailing realized-volatility proxy of the event-adjusted VXX close inside the frozen consumption set, not a foreign derivative shock series. D2 tests the claim by ancestry pooling -- including the specific risk that the proxy's roll/decay contamination makes the state behave like a disguised ETP shock form; that risk is named and pooled, not assumed away.
why_information_differs.momentum_63s: the shadow is long-horizon single-series price momentum; this proposal's state is a short-memory relative spread between an implied level and a realized proxy. The index-only shadow (below) additionally separates spread-state information from any ETP-NAV trend. D2 tests the claim.
why_information_differs.generic_dow_tue: the shadow is a calendar day-of-week effect; the calendar-clock shadow forces the rule to survive a weekday re-clock and the placebo destroys temporal structure while matching marginals.

ancestry_risk_statement.d2_test_of_claim: pooled ancestry |rho| within the frozen rubric margin against the full pooled inventory INCLUDING every shadow named above; margin recorded per rubric; failure is a D2 VETO, recorded, never argued away.

control_battery_spec.battery_law: the battery must be runnable on the frozen representation with the invalid-null distinction recorded (frozen rubric); the mandatory controls are vetoes, not suggestions (plan section 1 a+b).

index_only_shadow.spec: the identical spread-state rule with the ETP leg removed from the information set: the realized side is proxied from the vol INDEX series alone (trailing realized volatility of the VIX close itself over the same committed lookback), and the resulting placement is re-clocked onto the ETP legs -- no ETP price anywhere in the shadow's state. If the ETP-proxy placement is not distinct from its index-proxy re-clock, the ETP leg adds nothing and the proposal dies as an index re-clock.

cost_path_control.spec: the rule must survive the measured path-cost ladder, not a vendor-stated one: measured execution spreads scaled through the committed tier ladder (primary tier at the top), cost once per fill, and the Q-16 roll/decay path component carried explicitly at every tier (per-leg path formulas and adverse tails as committed in the frozen cost contract and the P2 gate). Kill before selection if any arm fails the ladder (frozen rubric: cost ceiling kill before selection).

calendar_clock_shadow.spec: the same rule re-clocked to a fixed weekday shift (symbolic shift k sessions, frozen at D2/S): a generic_dow_tue detector. A placement that survives the re-clock unchanged is a calendar artefact and dies.

placebo.spec: the spread-state series is time-shuffled with matched marginals and destroyed temporal ordering; the placement induced by the placebo must be indistinguishable from chance. A significant differential placement under the placebo kills the proposal.

control_battery_spec.invalid_null_distinction: an uncomputable state (warmup before the proxy lookback fills, refused tail, missing session) is INVALID and refused fail-closed; it is never coerced to NULL/neutral and never scored as a decision (Q-11).

falsification_rule.rule: PREREGISTERED KILL (one concrete condition): at D2, if the spread-state placement's after-cost expectancy on the primary NET book -- measured on the P2 bookable grid against event-adjusted ETP legs, after the FULL measured path-cost ladder at the primary stress tier with the Q-16 roll/decay component included -- is at or below zero, this proposal is KILLED and recorded as VOL_NG1_REJECT_ALL evidence. Additionally (identity, not a second numeric condition): any D2 result worded as the classic spot variance risk premium is invalid-null by the C8 limitation and cannot rescue the proposal. No threshold moves after any scored number is seen.
